correctness.rationale: The full zero-sum powered-distance quadratic form is exactly block diagonalized into the adjacency spectrum on the base and one apex--base mode. The first has maximal eigenvalue (s-1)(2h)^p-s, the second F(p,h)=k+(N-1-k)(2h)^p-2Nh^p. Both are necessary/sufficient, with unique roots and a unique crossing proved by monotonicity. Schoenberg rank counts give endpoint dimensions. Original analytic formula and all boundary cases were rederived; the packaged code independently reconstructs full matrices across nine test graphs and exactly checks rational crossover ranks. Finite tests are explicitly not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete, nontrivial continuum-parameter negative-type and minimum-affine-Hilbert-dimension classification holds for every regular graph with smallest adjacency eigenvalue at most -2; the least-eigenmode obstruction competes with the apex-balance mode and produces one unique crossover with simultaneous kernels. Applied to q-ary Hamming graphs, this yields an explicit high-multiplicity dimension drop (q-1)^d and a meaningful large-alphabet limit, beyond the old unweighted p=1 criterion.
